s.n: Last night in town spiced bar nuts
s.note: Mixed nuts roasted with brown sugar, smoked paprika, cayenne and rosemary
s.how: Heat the oven to 170C and line a tray with baking paper. Toss 400g mixed nuts with 30g melted butter, 2 tbsp brown sugar, the paprika, cayenne and rosemary. Spread on the tray and roast, stirring halfway, until golden and fragrant. Sprinkle with the salt and leave to cool on the tray so the coating sets crisp.

s.note: Thick onion rings in a crisp beer batter with smoky chipotle mayo
s.how: Separate the onion rings and toss in 2 tbsp of the flour. Whisk the rest of the flour with the cornflour, baking powder and salt, then whisk in 250ml cold lager to a thick batter. Heat the oil in a deep pot to 180C. Dip the rings in the batter and fry in batches for about 3 minutes until golden, then drain on paper towel. Stir the chipotle powder into the mayonnaise and serve with the hot rings.

m.note: Slow-cooked beef chilli with kidney beans, chipotle and cumin, with rice, sour cream and cheddar
m.how: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a heavy pot and brown 800g diced beef chuck in batches over high heat, then lift out. Turn the heat down and fry the onion, garlic and red capsicum in the same pot until soft. Stir in 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp chipotle powder, 1 tsp oregano and 2 tbsp tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Return the beef with 800g crushed tomatoes, 375ml beef stock and 1 tsp salt, cover and simmer on low until the beef falls apart. Add the drained kidney beans and simmer uncovered until thick. Meanwhile rinse 1.5 cups rice and simmer with 2.25 cups water, covered, until the water is absorbed. Serve the chilli over the rice with a spoon of sour cream and a handful of grated cheddar.

w.note: Crushed biscuit base, milk chocolate ganache and a toasted marshmallow top, cut into bars
w.how: Mix the crushed biscuits with the melted butter and press firmly into a lined 20cm square tin. Chill until firm. Heat the cream until steaming, pour over the chocolate, stir until smooth and spread over the base. Chill until set. Cover with the marshmallows and grill on high until toasted, watching closely. Cool for a few minutes and cut into 12 bars with a hot knife.

d.note: Bourbon, fresh lemon and honey syrup over ice, topped with soda
d.how: Stir the honey into the boiling water until dissolved and leave to cool. Shake the bourbon, lemon juice and honey syrup hard with a handful of ice. Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses, top with soda water and add a lemon slice.
